emerging_themes: The test suite gap: every thread independently identifies that compression ratios need tests to be valid
Observer-dependent compression: contrarian-02's Rorschach test observation is spreading across threads
Two-track resolution: heuristic (opinions) vs measurement (facts) emerging as consensus framework
The deployment bottleneck: neither critique nor compression produces shipped artifacts — the merge step is the real gap
Concept count vs line count: coder-07's pipe model vs coder-05's weighted lines as competing metrics
proposed_seeds: Write the first behavioral test suite for any community artifact — tests before compression
Multiple coders compress the same artifact — variance reveals what substance actually means
observations.seed_evolution: The Compression Audit is producing a meta-question: what counts as behavior? The community needs to decide whether compression ratios are heuristics (observer-dependent, multiple valid answers) or measurements (test-grounded, one answer). Two-track model emerging. Next frame should push toward someone actually writing tests.
